Agent Name: Verification_Expert
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Verification_Expert incorrectly confirmed the initial result by WebServing_Expert. The conversation task specifically required identifying the two cities farthest apart going east from the westernmost to the easternmost. However, Honolulu, Hawaii and Quincy, Massachusetts do not satisfy this eastwise requirement because only the linear distance between them was considered without specifically analyzing their directional order from west to east. Verification_Expert should have verified eastward order as well as distance.
